Definition: from a compound of G5043 and G5142; to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent:--bring up children.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to bring up children, to rear them. A widow to be taken into the number must be well reported of for good works: if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work, and if she have brought up children.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bringing up children is counted among the good works, and the widow's life is the proof of it.
